defaultExpectation: Original gold allocations and review requirement; overrides below are separate experiment expectations, never input to decisions.
surplusRule: Only one explicitly named issued notice, unambiguous organization/tenant/lease identity, all original reference/conflict checks pass, positive integer ore and positive outstanding debt. Allocate at most that notice debt. Preserve remainder in separate credit with organization, tenant, lease, bank event and notice provenance.
ordinaryPayments: Keep reference+period policy for ordinary payments including existing partial/combined allocation; never spend or move credit to any notice.
unsupported: Paid/cancelled/credited notices, fees/interest, refunds, credit use, reversal and accounting integration require separate policy/integration; no new execution path for these.
humanReviewRule: Credit creates a continuing human obligation, even with correct identification and simulated allocation. Human review payments count every originating payment once. Queue placement is not a successful allocation.
caseRule: Group pending credits by (organization, tenant), with every bank event retained. Unresolved identity/conflict payments remain individual unresolved cases; do not group by gold owner or claim independent customers.
creditPendingDecisions: Fastställd kontohantering och beständig ekonomisk redovisning
Bekräfta ägare och fortsatt hantering av kvarvarande tillgodo
Separat beslut före återbetalning eller användning mot annan avi
runtimeBoundary: Only Bank/Notice typed values and stable org-scoped event id enter the policy; never gold, scenario type or overrides. Same public projection as #869 with unique=False; no bank reference variants.
atomicityBoundary: Immutable in-memory state staged before one return; injected crash never publishes partial debt/credit state. Stable event id dedup only in memory. No persistence, database locks or real import identity verified.
